series_label: Antenatal care 4+ visits - percentage of women (aged 15-49 years) attended at least four times during pregnancy by any provider [Age=15 to 49 years old]
source_or_custodian: United Nations (UNICEF data, via United Nations Statistics Division); provenance undata/p/UNICEF
status_or_notes: Only 8 observations exist for Nigeria in the 2000-2025 window (2003, 2008, 2011, 2013, 2017, 2018, 2021, 2024). No values returned for 2000-2002 or 2025, and the years 2004-2007, 2009-2010, 2012, 2014-2016, 2019-2020, 2022-2023 have no observation. Observation period P1Y. Metadata facet date range 2003-2024. Values are as returned by the server; no uncertainty intervals were provided. Other ANC4+ variables on the server (by urbanization or wealth quintile, and undata/unicef/MNCH_ANC4.AGE--Y15T19 for ages 15-19) were not used because the question asks for all women aged 15-49.
definition: Percentage of women (aged 15-49 years) attended at least four times during pregnancy by any provider (name of the statistical variable; no further definition returned by the server).
